fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles on both sides and overhead.
• Post the property address visibly at the front entry area to help responders confirm they have reached the correct location.
• Mark or label all access points, including any gates, so responders can quickly identify entry options on arrival.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items that would block responder vehicle positioning or movement.
• Trim dense vegetation near the detached structure to allow responders to approach and work around all sides of the building.
• Keep rear access points unlocked or secured with a means responders can quickly defeat, such as a breakaway lock or knox box.
• Cut back vegetation along walkways so responders carrying equipment can move without obstruction.
• Mark any gates in the perimeter fencing that provide access to the rear of the property with reflective indicators visible at night.
• Thin dense plantings in landscaped areas adjacent to the residence so responders have a clear path to exterior walls and windows.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or touch the house.
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees.
• Remove brush growing within the immediate area around the house.
• Clear ground vegetation growing against the base of the structure.
• Trim low-hanging branches on scattered trees near the house to raise the canopy off the ground.
• Cut back scattered shrubs that are close to the structure or touching exterior walls.
• Keep the area between the brush zone and the house free of dead plant material and dry grass.
• Maintain open ground between the brush area and any outbuildings or fencing connected to the house.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation.
• Remove any dead wood or dry debris that has collected under large trees near the structure.
